## The authoring problem / 만들면서 겪는 어려움

What are you trying to create, and what gets in the way?

## Desired outcome / 원하는 결과

Describe what should become possible through the canvas or labeled controls.

## Interaction and accessibility

How could someone use this with a keyboard or reduced motion? Suggestions are welcome; a complete design is not required.

## Alternatives and scope

Any existing workaround, related issue or smaller first step?

Reisian is a local-first, visual-only alpha. Feature requests are proposals, not delivery commitments.
